# WebsiteClosers Business-for-Sale Listings Scraper

WebsiteClosers is a business brokerage marketplace listing established e-commerce stores, SaaS products, agencies, Amazon FBA brands and other online businesses for sale. This actor pulls those listings — live or sold — as structured records with asking price, cash flow, revenue and broker contact, so you can screen deals without opening each listing by hand.

## What this actor does

- Browses every current live listing, filters to one of 67 industry categories, or runs a keyword search across titles and descriptions
- Looks up a historical archive of already-closed/sold deals, whose detail pages often still disclose the original financials
- Fetches an exact set of listing URLs directly instead of browsing
- Applies asking-price, cash-flow, gross-income, year-established and employee-count range filters after reading each listing's real financials, since the site's own browse-page sort and range widgets aren't reliable
- Omits any field a listing didn't disclose — no empty strings, nulls or placeholder zeros in the output

## Output per business listing

- `listingId`
- `title`, `description`
- `askingPrice`, `cashFlow`, `grossIncome` — in USD, when disclosed
- `yearEstablished`
- `employees` — headcount, when disclosed
- `status` — e.g. `Available` or `Closed`
- `category`, `categoryName` — industry slug and friendly name (mode=byCategory)
- `brokerTeam`, `brokerCode` — the brokerage team representing the listing (e.g. `WC 4062`)
- `postedBy` — individual broker credited on category archive pages, when shown
- `datePublished`
- `imageUrl` — listing photo
- `sourceUrl` — canonical listing URL
- `recordType: "businessListing"`, `scrapedAt`

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `browse` | `browse` (all live listings), `byCategory`, `search`, `closedDeals` or `byUrls` |
| `category` | string | `ecommerce-online-retail` | One of 67 industry categories (mode=byCategory) |
| `searchQuery` | string | – | Keyword to search titles and descriptions (mode=search) |
| `listingUrls` | array | `[]` | Direct listing URLs to fetch (mode=byUrls) |
| `minAskingPrice` | integer | – | Drop listings priced below this, USD |
| `maxAskingPrice` | integer | – | Drop listings priced above this, USD |
| `minCashFlow` | integer | – | Drop listings with annual cash flow below this, USD |
| `maxCashFlow` | integer | – | Drop listings with annual cash flow above this, USD |
| `minGrossIncome` | integer | – | Drop listings with annual gross revenue below this, USD |
| `minYearEstablished` | integer | – | Drop listings established before this year |
| `minEmployees` | integer | – | Drop listings with fewer employees than this, where disclosed |
| `maxEmployees` | integer | – | Drop listings with more employees than this, where disclosed |
| `maxItems` | integer | `50` | Hard cap on emitted records (1–2000) |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | Apify proxy | Not required for this target; left available for resilience |

### Example: profitable businesses over $1M cash flow

```json
{
  "mode": "browse",
  "minCashFlow": 1000000,
  "maxItems": 30
}
```

### Example: SaaS businesses for sale

```json
{
  "mode": "byCategory",
  "category": "software-saas",
  "maxItems": 25
}
```

### Example: Amazon FBA keyword search

```json
{
  "mode": "search",
  "searchQuery": "Amazon FBA",
  "maxItems": 20
}
```

### Example: look up specific listings by URL

```json
{
  "mode": "byUrls",
  "listingUrls": [
    "https://www.websiteclosers.com/businesses/sba-pre-qualified-luxury-resale-business-2-luxury-brands-17-year-business-experienced-staff-in-place-33-yoy-profit-growth/119151/"
  ]
}
```

## Use cases

- **Buy-side deal sourcing** — export current listings and screen them against your own acquisition criteria
- **Valuation benchmarking** — compare asking price to cash-flow and revenue multiples across a category
- **Market monitoring** — track which business types are actively being brokered and at what price points
- **Historical deal research** — pull the closed-deals archive to see what similar businesses actually sold for
- **Deal-flow alerts** — re-run on a schedule and diff against a previous export to spot new listings

## FAQ

**Is this affiliated with WebsiteClosers?**
No. This is an independent actor that reads WebsiteClosers' publicly available listing pages; it is not affiliated with or endorsed by WebsiteClosers.

**Are asking price and cash flow always filled in?**
Most live listings disclose an asking price; cash flow, gross income, year established and employee count appear only when the broker chose to disclose them. Anything undisclosed is simply left out of the record.

**Why don't listings show a location?**
WebsiteClosers doesn't publish a location on individual listing pages, consistent with buyer-confidentiality practice in business brokerage, so there's no location field to extract.

**Why does the actor filter by price/cash-flow itself instead of using the site's own range controls?**
The live browse page's own sort and price-range widgets don't reliably return filtered results, so this actor fetches each listing's real financials and applies your range filters afterward for consistent results.

**What does `closedDeals` mode return?**
A historical archive of deals that have already sold or closed. Many of those detail pages remain live and still show the original asking price, cash flow, gross income and employee count.

**How many listings are available at once?**
A few hundred live listings spread across 67 categories at any given time, plus a separate historical closed-deals archive.

**How current is the data?**
Every run reads the live site directly, so results reflect the marketplace's current state with no caching delay.
